_help.country_indeed: Indeed/Glassdoor country, e.g. india, usa, uk, canada, germany, uae, singapore
_help.sites: any of linkedin, indeed, naukri (India only), glassdoor, google, zip_recruiter (US/CA), bayt (Gulf)
_help.search_terms: 6-8 job titles to search; the first quick_terms are used by --quick
_help.locations: cities to search, most preferred first; tier must exist in tiers; the first quick_locations are used by --quick
_help.tiers: match = words that identify that area inside a posting's location text (include state codes like KL/KA used by Indeed); bonus = pre-score points
_help.skills: lower-case keywords from the resume; a job must mention at least one
_help.max_years_required: drop jobs whose minimum experience asked is above this (fresher: 1)
_help.exclude_title_words: drop jobs whose title contains any of these words
_help.title_must_match: regex fragments; the title must match at least one (leave [] to allow all)
_help.level_signals: words that mean the job suits this person's level; gives a pre-score boost
